messages:
jamal: Heads-up — FinTrust asked us to fill Q12 in the SIG: 'Describe data flow and tenant isolation controls'. They want a short narrative + artifacts (diagram, network policy, smoke test). Can we put this together by EOD tomorrow?

maria: I can draft the narrative. Need a clear arch diagram + k8s/network policy example. @alex can you confirm KMS/encryption details?

alex: On it. Will provide draw.io export + redacted traffic flow image. NOTE: do NOT include internal IPs or node hostnames in artifacts. I'll attach a k8s namespace + NetworkPolicy snippet and the S3 prefix example.

sarah: For sec review, please include: threat-model bullets (flow→controls→justification), tenant-isolation smoke test steps + results, and a note on our breach containment/circuit-breaker behavior. Also want timestamps for the smoke test.

nina: I can package everything for upload. Proposed artifact names: diag-redwood-dataflow-v1.png, k8s-namespace-policy.yaml, kms-rotation-policy.pdf, tenant-isolation-smoketest-2026-03-18.log.zip. Where should I push? GDrive or S3?

jamal: Quick wording Q — can we say 'logical multitenancy with strong tenant-scoped access controls' or do we need to call out 'no co-mingling of customer data at rest'?

alex: Be explicit: 'tenant data stored in separate prefixes with KMS keys per-tenant (hosted), or customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private.' I'll add exact config lines in the snippet.

maria: Draft narrative (v0): 'Redwood enforces tenant isolation via separate storage prefixes, per-tenant encryption keys, network segmentation at namespace level, and RBAC enforced by the control plane. Authentication is delegated to customer IdP or Redwood-managed tokens.' Taking edits now.

sarah: Add eval metrics: isolation latency p95 from POC, CPU isolation snapshot, and the noisy-tenant remediation steps. Also include acceptance criteria for smoke test.

jamal: FYI FinTrust also asked if we can provide a notarized attestation or SOC-like doc later — flagging for legal. For now SIG artifacts first.

sig-bot: Checklist update — artifacts expected: diag-redwood-dataflow-v1.png (pending), k8s-namespace-policy.yaml (pending), tenant-isolation-smoketest-2026-03-18.log.zip (pending).

nina: Uploaded diagram + yamls to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED. Zipped logs and removed node names per request.

alex: Posted example snippets in-thread for clarity:
```bash
# example s3 prefix
s3://redwood-hosted/customer-<cust-id>/data/
# kms key alias
alias/redwood/cust-<cust-id>
```
and a trimmed NetworkPolicy example: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: isolate-tenant-ns
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tenant: "<cust-id>"
```
maria: Updated the narrative to mention 'per-tenant KMS key aliasing' and a short remediation plan for noisy tenants. PTAL @sarah @alex.

sarah: LGTM, one minor edit: change 'customer-managed for Dedicated' -> 'customer-managed for Dedicated and Private deployments'.

jamal: Owners: @nina create final ZIP for SIG portal, @maria finalize narrative, @alex redact + attach config snippets, @sarah sign off. Target: tomorrow 18:00 PST. Any blockers?

alex: No blockers. Will include a minimal terraform snippet with resource names abstracted and confirm KMS rotation policy doc.

nina: Final upload done: https://s3.redwood.example/sig-packages/fintrust-sig-1763805123.zip (share link pending). Removed identifying hostnames and internal IPs.

jamal: :thumbsup: I'll push this to FinTrust's questionnaire portal once @sarah signs off. Thanks all.
